purpose: Fresh clean end-to-end proof of plain-language rendered-browser interaction after verified interaction promotion and compiler binding.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://httpbin.org/forms/post. Enter PROJECT BRAIN into the customer name field, choose Medium pizza size, check the Bacon topping, submit the form, and save a full-page screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/HTTPBIN_FORM_SUBMITTED.png and a result JSON to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/HTTPBIN_FORM_SUBMITTED.json. The final rendered page must independently show the submitted customer name PROJECT BRAIN, size Medium, and topping Bacon; do not count merely opening or screenshotting the form as success.

steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
python - <<'PY'
import json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/HTTPBIN_FORM_SUBMITTED.json')
if not p.is_file(): raise SystemExit('RESULT_JSON_MISSING')
x=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
blob=' '.join(str(x.get(k,'')) for k in ('observed_text','text','body','page_text','final_url'))
need=['PROJECT BRAIN','Medium','Bacon']
missing=[v for v in need if v.lower() not in blob.lower()]
if missing: raise SystemExit('POST_SUBMIT_VALUES_MISSING:'+','.join(missing))
print('BROWSER_INTERACTION_EFFECT_VERIFIED')
PY
